script.title: Pelican Express
script.description: A white pelican pedals a blue bicycle, leaning into the grips with its wings. Its enormous golden bill and hanging orange throat pouch lead the way; black flight feathers, offset webbed feet, a streaming red scarf and a rear fish crate complete the coastal commuter.
